title: Model Capabilities Tests
summary: This module contains integration tests for various model capabilities, including audio transcription, image generation, embedding, quantization, thinking mode, tool calling, and multi-modal vision tasks.

nodes.label: Audio Processing Tests
nodes.title: Audio Processing Tests
nodes.description: Tests models' ability to transcribe audio and respond to audio input, including OpenAI API compatibility.

nodes.label: Image Generation Tests
nodes.title: Image Generation Tests
nodes.description: Verifies the creation and functionality of image generation models, including image output validation.

nodes.label: Embedding Functionality Tests
nodes.title: Embedding Functionality Tests
nodes.description: Evaluates model embedding capabilities, including cosine similarity, batch processing, truncation, and handling large inputs.

nodes.label: Model Creation Tests
nodes.title: Model Creation Tests
nodes.description: Tests the creation of models from Safetensors and GGUF formats, ensuring proper setup and basic functionality.

nodes.label: Quantization Tests
nodes.title: Quantization Tests
nodes.description: Validates the quantization process for models, checking different quantization levels and their impact on model output.

nodes.label: Thinking Mode Tests
nodes.title: Thinking Mode Tests
nodes.description: Examines models' 'thinking' capabilities, verifying structured thought processes and proper suppression when not requested.

nodes.label: Tool Calling Tests
nodes.title: Tool Calling Tests
nodes.description: Assesses models' ability to use external tools, including stress tests for complex multi-tool scenarios.

nodes.label: Vision Capabilities Tests
nodes.title: Vision Capabilities Tests
nodes.description: Tests multi-modal vision models for tasks like multi-turn conversations, object counting, scene understanding, spatial reasoning, detail recognition, and multi-image input.

nodes.label: Model Architecture Tests
nodes.title: Model Architecture Tests
nodes.description: Verifies chat and embedding functionality across various model architectures, considering VRAM constraints and GPU loading.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: Provides the HTTP API for interacting with the model serving and management system.

nodes.label: Model Creation and Conversion
nodes.title: Model Creation and Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the creation and conversion of models from various formats into the system's internal representation.

groups.label: Functional Validation
groups.title: Functional Validation
groups.description: Tests verifying specific capabilities and features of the models.
